criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame stands in a world with haze, a horizon and contact shadows on 5, 8 and 9. The hero is a primitive, a slab hull with stacked frustums and a T-bar mast, which reads as a lighthouse on 2 and a toy on 1, 3 and 8. The light is flat. Frames 4 and 7 are diagrams in fog with the hero a speck and frame 7's lower part a flat black slab. Frame 6 has a cylinder flag, a hat brim through a ponytail, a head cropped at the edge and no readable window. The deckhouse rises behind frame 5's dek, the radome touches frame 1's dek, and frame 3's range label runs outside the safe zone. A smear band sits at the foot of most frames. Frames 8 and 5 are the strongest, 20 people and 7 vests countable on 8.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one grade, one accent for plan figures, one hull through its states, medians held with one declared dip. The 05 to 09 bookend lands. The motif breaks at feed size on 4 and 7.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, company figures are attributed and the vessel is labelled illustrative on every frame that shows it. The county decision rests on the Tribune where a primary exists. The first comment omits c4.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: The reader learns what, who, where and the terms. Nothing to do next.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Frames 2 and 3 detour into company claims, 4, 5 and 7 are three yard-size frames, the turn restates the cover, the close lands reasonably.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on register but procedural, disclaimers and Saronic says on most frames, little regional texture.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: The ship and the bluebonnet accent are new. The highNoon sky and a hearing room repeat no. 42, the same-camera close and the person and pickup on bare ground repeat no. 44, and the aerial with accent strips repeats no. 44's raked lines.

one_sentence_fix: Rebuild the hero hull as a real ship model and rake the sun so the hull carries a lit flank and a shadow side.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat near-black water slab in the lower part, the hero a speck, the positions a CAD overlay in fog
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera to about 60 m over the channel edge looking along the quay with the hull berthed at 15% of the width, and crop the water to a fifth of the height

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: An aerial diagram in fog with no hero at legible size and a banded foreground strip
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower to an oblique about 300 m up from over the channel with the hull moored large at the near bank

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A cylinder flag, a hat brim through a ponytail, a head cropped at the edge, no readable window
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Remove the flag, swap the hatted figure for a hatless one, delete the cropped head, and throw a sun patch across the dais front

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: At close range the deckhouse reads as a monument, with little sun and shade separation
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model sensor arms, radome, whips and stanchions and rotate the sun so the near faces are 20 L* apart

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The deckhouse rises behind the dek
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pan the camera about 6 degrees right or drop the hull so the deckhouse sits below the dek's last line

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat overhead light, the radome touching the dek, streaked water
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Rake the key light and lower the hull about 30 px so the mast clears the dek
